description: We're a group of easy-going people with a shared interest in cybersecurity and technology. We enjoy learning new things, sharing ideas, and figuring out how things work. We're looking for creative, open-minded, and hardworking people who aren't afraid to take on challenges and think differently. You don't have to be an expert; just bring your curiosity, enthusiasm, and willingness to learn. Good vibes, strong teamwork, and a little hacker mindset are all we need.
